top_issues.finding: An accepted source clarification is checked only for membership in sourceReferences. The provider can include the chosen destination as an unused reference and bind navigation to the rejected destination; that plan is accepted and materialized.
top_issues.suggested_action: Persist the disputed semantic input/occurrence and slot with each source question. Bind the accepted choice to that exact obligation/reference use during plan admission and action validation; reject unused-choice or alternative-reference substitution. Test both source choices through actual navigation and independent destination receipts, including an adversarial plan containing both references.

top_issues.finding: The actual coordinator chooses proposals whenever a plan exists, ignoring MATERIALIZE continuation. A restart after source-plan acceptance and before materialization sends another provider request with no runner context, leaving materialization absent. The adjacent NEXT-before-first-pushContext window also has no recovery path by source inspection.
top_issues.suggested_action: Dispatch from durable continuation/bootstrap state rather than plan existence alone. Recover materialization, dependency allocation and acknowledged context/bootstrap stages idempotently before next-action inference. Add actual continueRuns probes after plan acceptance, after materialization, and after NEXT commits but before first context delivery. Do not recreate a lost post-effect browser or resend an action.

top_issues.finding: Late usage reconciliation occurs only at route entry in a separate transaction. A known 200000-input-token receipt committed after that check but before fresh reservation/send is ignored until another route invocation; the next actual SDK HTTP request is sent despite the fixed 128000 ceiling. Repairs inside call() also do not rerun reconciliation.
top_issues.suggested_action: Reconcile immutable late usage under the same session lock as each attempt reservation and committed send claim, including repairs/recovery. Commit overage and terminal refusal before allowing another send, charge each receipt once, and retain accounting without reviving terminal sessions. Test receipt arrival between entry reconciliation and reservation/claim.

top_issues.finding: AC-6 prompt-injection coverage is absent from the semantic corpus. The approved-provider harness contains four SOURCE_PLAN cases and no hostile observed-page/context instruction case or NEXT_ACTION malicious permitted-action substitution oracle. HTTP error-text and duplicate-JSON tests do not exercise this semantic boundary.
top_issues.suggested_action: Add frozen synthetic prompt-injection and malicious permitted-action/target/value/assertion substitutions to controlled fixtures and the opt-in approved-provider harness. Include sanitized current-page evidence and independent expected outcomes/receipts; prove the oracle rejects the unsafe typed reply. Keep unavailable live execution explicit; no live benchmark, arbitrary-English proof or OBS-009/010 work is required.
evidence: Source inspection of translation tests, planning fixtures and the four-case evaluation corpus

A committed accepted plan followed by pre-materialization interruption does not resume through the actual scanner (REL-001).

Given classified source, private saved inputs and fresh page-value canaries, concrete SDK HTTP requests retain deliberately authored London and exclude resolved saved/secret/account/capture values across planning/action/repair/error channels. Positive field construction keeps Sources/runnerContext private; credential screening makes no universal-secret claim.
tests: both actual clarification destination-receipt cases rerun

acceptance_traceability.given_when_then: Typed compact schemas, one committed send claim, original authority tuple, conservative reservations and immutable usage work in existing cases. Given late overage committed between route-entry reconciliation and fresh reservation, the actual provider is called again (REL-002).

Current evidence and admitted obligations feed same-instance production StepVerifier; stale source/plan/fence/observation and changed input/predicate refuse; one submit and actual final assertion pass. An explicitly chosen source can remain unused while the action takes the other input (SEC-001). This is explicit-choice integrity, not arbitrary-English proof.

Actual public source/observed questions and atomic meaning persist; both observed selected fields receive CAPTURE and the unselected field stays empty after service reconstruction. Source choice is not bound to its obligation use (SEC-001), and pre-context continuation does not recover (REL-001).

boundary_assessment.production_source: Concrete current locked ui_tests, immutable manifests, exact span/config materialization and same-instance StepVerifier reviewed. AccountAccess is the only controlled account seam.
boundary_assessment.privacy: Positive-field projection; opaque saved/config/binding references; raw model responses ephemeral; strict parsing/MVC advice. No disclosure reproduced.
boundary_assessment.gateway: Shared bounded capacity, credentials/deadline/cancel, no implicit HTTP followup, pinned self-contained strict/provider schemas and compact authority rejection retained.
boundary_assessment.usage: Checked primary+tool input and candidate+thought output; cached prompt not added twice, missing primary unknown. Immediate thought overage and stale late audit joined cases pass; concurrent reconciliation/send remains REL-002.
boundary_assessment.database: Reviewed V32 scoped FKs, one live attempt, immutable manifests/plans/usage, single-assignment associations, null-rejecting checks and lock order. Nine actual PG migration/concurrency cases pass. Fresh V32 and targeted V31 foundation remain distinct.
boundary_assessment.obligations: One-to-one obligation/admission and independent one-submit receipt through lost result/reconstruction pass. Model IDs cannot mint new effects; source-answer use is not enforced (SEC-001).
boundary_assessment.completion: Mandatory ledger/assertion reconciliation; default no VERIFY_STEP; optional charged model verification cannot waive missing effects. Source-plan meaning remains evaluated, not proved.
boundary_assessment.continuation: Bean presence/manual service reconstruction missed the actual continueRuns failure. Reproduced MATERIALIZE window; source-confirmed adjacent NEXT-before-first-context window shares REL-001.
boundary_assessment.normal_replay: Exact transport caller allowlist, direct/transitive mutation oracles and ordinary service-to-HTTP-dispatch dual-gateway zero-call tests reviewed; no broad allowlist.
boundary_assessment.evaluation: Live provider explicitly unavailable. Four source-plan cases do not cover AC-6 hostile observed content.
